arun: Quick sync 1: need a compact spec for the continuous batching/queueing panels we want in the console prototype. Maya/Tom/Sophie please chime in. I added a short table in the shared doc: https://redwood.sheets/queueing-panels
maya: From runtime, we'll emit a minimal set of Prom primitives. Proposed names and types:
- `redwood_batch_wait_ms_histogram{model,pool,zone}` (Prom histogram)
- `redwood_batch_size_histogram{model,pool,zone}` (Prom histogram)
- `redwood_batch_fill_ratio{pool}` (gauge 0..1)
- `redwood_kv_cache_hit_ratio{model}` (gauge)
Note: avoid high-cardinality labels by default. Route-level visibility via sampled exemplars only.
arun: Good. For histogram bucket choices, suggest something that captures sub-ms tails too. Maya, any numbers?
maya: Suggested `le` buckets for wait_ms: 0.5,1,2,5,10,25,50,100,250,500,1000,+Inf. For batch size: 1,2,4,8,12,16,24,32,48,64,+Inf. These reflect our trace samples where small batches dominate but we see occasional spikes to 64.

Also plan to emit sampled `route` as an exemplars label at ~0.5% to allow top-N route rollups without exploding cardinality. We'll also attach trace exemplars to high-latency buckets (exemplar=trace_id).

tom: From infra/dispatcher side we need two dispatcher-level signals:
- `dispatcher_queue_utilization{pool,zone}` gauge 0..1
- `dispatcher_backpressure_count_total{pool,zone}` counter
We should keep `route` off these metrics at ingest to avoid cardinality; route rollups will be done by the metrics pipeline via sample joins.

sophie: UX requirements from Console:
- Landing card: p95 wait (per pool, hover shows p50/p99)
- Heatmap: batch size distribution over the last 6h (stacked heatmap)
- Saturation bar: current `dispatcher_queue_utilization` with color thresholds
- Route drilldown: top 10 routes by requests with p95 wait + avg batch size
Can we get sampled route exemplars so we can attribute the heatmap spikes to routes?

maya: Yes. We'll attach exemplars on a sampling rate config (default 0.5%). We'll also emit a small sampled counter `redwood_batch_request_sampled_total{route}` for cardinality-limited rollups. Implementation detail: exemplars require trace ids from the tracing library; we can only attach them when a trace is present.

arun: Alerts proposal:
- Page if `dispatcher_queue_utilization > 0.85` AND `redwood_batch_fill_ratio < 0.6` for 5m
- Warn if p95 wait > 250ms for a pool for 3m
- Add a runbook note to correlate p95 wait and `redwood_kv_cache_hit_ratio` drops

maya: Sample PromQLs to include in the PR and dashboard JSON:
```
# p95 wait per pool
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_batch_wait_ms_histogram_bucket[5m])) by (le,pool,model))
# batch size heatmap series (panel uses bucket ranges)
sum(rate(redwood_batch_size_histogram_bucket[5m])) by (le,pool)
# dispatcher utilization
max_over_time(dispatcher_queue_utilization[5m])
# fill ratio
avg_over_time(redwood_batch_fill_ratio[5m])
```

tom: Ops notes:
- I'll open a metrics-registry PR for canonical naming and proto changes. Runtime protobuf needs a small bump; target agent version 2.8.0 in that PR.
- We'll avoid per-instance labels for these metrics but include `zone` and `pool` so dashboards can group by infra.
- The metrics pipeline will create daily rollups for per-route top-N by joining sampled counters and exemplars.

ci-bot: metrics-registry PR opened: https://git.redwood/metrics/+/1299. CI: failing tests on histogram serialization format. @maya please take a look.

maya: I'll push a fix for the serialization in ~90m. Also adding a feature flag to toggle exemplar sampling at runtime so we can ramp safely.

sophie: Timeline: Can we get a skeleton dashboard by EOD Thursday? I want to mock the heatmap and the drilldown flow before the sprint planning review.

tom: I'll add a skeleton under `grafana/dashboards/queueing-batching-heatmap.json` with placeholder panels wired to the PromQL above. Will include variables for pool/model/zone and a top-N route variable that reads from the sampled rollup metric.

arun: Ownership: runtime -> maya, metrics pipeline/rollups -> tom, console/dashboard -> sophie. If CI is green and the proto change lands, let's target an internal canary to validate the panels next week.

sophie: Also UX note: default console card set should be compact for small orgs (only pool-level) and expandable for enterprise customers (route-level drilldowns). Will add mockups to the sheet.

arun: Thanks all. Closing thread; ping here if CI isn't fixed or if dashboard skeleton needs other queries.
